page.overview:
Who is Edvard Noriega?

Edvard is a man with blonde hair who appears to have an undercut with stripes under it. He wears a T-shirt covered with the letter "E" all over it. He has thick, black eyebrows and wears a pearl necklace under his shirt.

During his relationship with Penelope, he had been constantly abusing her and selling her belongings. After her mother convinced her to break up with him, he threatened to ruin Penelope if she tried to get involved.

A while after they break up, Edvard meets Penelope again and begs for help because he had been stalked by a mysterious man with black wings.

Edvard is the ex-boyfriend of Penelope. He had been constantly abusing her and selling all of her items and even threatened to ruin her life when her mother tried to break them up. He had emotionally traumatized Penelope and later broke up with her. A while later, on her way to work, Penelope and Jorge run into Edvard. He begs for help, claiming that he is going to die. She attempts to ignore him and brush him off, but he claims that he had seen a man with wings, who is trying to kill him. This angers Penelope, she snaps and shouts at him, saying that he deserves everything that would come to him. Ignoring her, he continues to explain the story. Penelope then threatens to kill him if he does not leave. The ground begins to move and creates four walls surrounding Edvard. Jorge realizes that Penelope has created a locked room and is about to strangle him.
